packet_assembly.resources: In each run's resources order, use its arm's exact text/hash from instructions.json.
packet_assembly.input: The matching inputs.json entry with its id replaced by the run id; JSON indentation 2, Unicode preserved.
packet_assembly.transient_files: work/review-quality/packets; remove after reconstruction check. Prefixes preserve the literal original output paths without granting permission to write them during replay.

application.input_source_case: RM01 from the preceding disclosed maintenance corpus
application.acceptance_correction: Terminal flags can coexist with inaccessible count/pending payload; effective-phase burden survives.

followup.source_access: Only original behavior/API document, no implementations or reviews.
followup.order: Request written and read before application editor launch.
followup.disclosure_limit: Exact followup contract withheld from application editor; accepted scope named reset among excluded extra capabilities.

application.preservation: Error, Encoder and Decoded prefix verified byte-identical before followup. After followup existing decoding bodies unchanged in each variant. Static comparison only.
application.runtime_status: NOT RUN by explicit code-only scope
